annotations.text:
LIFE LEVEL — Command Center + Season Track + Talents

Home replaces the scroll feed with a game main menu; the Season Track is the battle-pass spine it points to, now with a proper claimed/locked/pending/ready state system instead of a single CLAIM button. Season 2 proves the pass actually refreshes. Talents is a new, separate screen: a Diablo-style per-skill upgrade tree + paragon board.

HOME — COMMAND CENTER

• Loadout hero: avatar + class + equipped title + 5 stat gems + one POWER score.
• Season ribbon always on screen — tier, bar, next reward, countdown. Tap → Season Track.
• 'Today' deck: Daily Quests, Week 3 Expedition, XP Storm (LIVE, pulsing), Forest Warden.
• One primary action: START SESSION.

SEASON 1 TRACK — corrected: four real states, no claim button

Every reward slot now reads its state at a glance instead of relying on one bottom CLAIM button:

• RECEIVED — greyed out, small green check badge (Tiers 5–6 free lane).
• LOCKED — greyed out, lock icon overlay. Covers both 'tier not reached yet' (Tiers 9–10 free) AND 'Founder not purchased' (the whole Founder lane, every tier, until it's bought — this was inconsistent before and is now uniform).
• PENDING — full-strength orange ring, the very next tier you're actively progressing toward (Tier 8, tracks the same XP bar up top: '640 XP to go').
• READY — green ring + glow + a round + icon on the right edge, the whole tile is the tap target. Tier 7's Ember Cache — no separate CLAIM button anywhere on the screen.

A small legend under the track keys all four. Founder lane kept exactly as before, just consistently locked until purchased.

SEASON 2 — 'Tide Reckoning', same system, proves the refresh

Same exact component (states, legend, Founder banner, milestone card) — different season. Brand accent swaps from ember-orange to a teal 'brand' colour (state colours — orange=pending, green=ready — stay universal across seasons for usability). Earlier in its arc: Tier 3 ready, Tier 4 pending, only Tiers 1–2 received. Rewards reworded to the Ocean of Balance chapter (Pearl Cache, Tidewalker Cloak, Tide Sovereign's Blessing at Tier 25) using the same reward-type art, plus one bespoke finale image (zone_coral_coast).

TALENTS — rebuilt to match the reference screenshots directly

Same hex-badge gacha-RPG grammar as the reference: a ribboned 'TALENTS' banner with diamond flourishes + info button, a 3-currency header row, a 4-column grid of gold-bordered hex badges (icon + Lv.X pill, a green up-arrow badge on anything upgradeable), and a big spotlighted hex — starburst backdrop, paging chevrons either side, name + level in large type, an effect line underneath, a round + button riding its corner — previewing whichever talent from the grid is focused (Steel Resolve here). A gold 'Draw Talent Card' pull button with two currency costs sits below the grid, exactly where the reference puts it.

Recast with Life-Level's own content instead of the reference's dice game: the five core stats as the top row (First Rep · Iron Lungs · Quick Start · Focus Mastery), then Second Wind / Steel Resolve / Nimble Step / Dexterity, then combat and utility nodes (Direct Hit, Fair Exchange, Strength), then mastery tiers (Sturdy, Recovery, 1-/2-Rep Mastery) — all built from real in-app icons (stat gems, streak fire, streak shield, XP sparkle).

Corrected to the app's own palette: the reference's navy-and-gold gacha look is gone — this now sits on the same near-black ground as every other screen, hex frames and the featured glow use the app's --purple token, currency numbers borrow the existing semantic colours (purple/orange/blue), and 'Draw Talent Card' uses the same blue→purple gradient as Home's START SESSION. One consistent design system, not a bolted-on theme.
